description: DiligenceOps: submit a pricing page’s tier descriptions, as text or as tiers with price, limits and features, and the plan terms. The signed report reads each tier’s price, limits and features from sections or tier columns and lists the prices, limits (another figure, or a cap on an unlimited one) and features (excluded, a paid add-on, or named for another tier) that differ between the page and the terms, with quotes. POST /api/pricing-tier-check. Reads only the material in the call: no page fetch, no account access, no merchant contact and no money movement. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. The report matches words, figures, dates and named items between the submitted texts; it does not interpret meaning beyond that matching. Contract: /api/diligence-vendor-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/diligence-checks/.

currency.description: Currency for prices that omit one.

format.description: html reduces the markup to readable text first. Defaults to html when the text starts with a tag, otherwise text.

terms.description: The plan terms, order form or plan descriptions the tiers are checked against, up to 256 KB.

terms_label.description: Optional name for the material, recorded in the report.

anyOf.description: The pricing page tier descriptions as text.

currency.description: Currency or token code, for example USD, EUR or USDC.

features.description: Optional features as published, one per item.

limits.description: Optional limits as published, for example "Up to 10 users" or "Unlimited projects".

name.description: The tier as the pricing page names it, for example "Pro".

period.description: Optional billing period of the price.

text.description: Optional tier description as published, read for its price, limits and features.

tiers.description: The tiers as published: the pricing page as text, or up to 20 tiers as {name, price, period, features, limits, text}.

tiers_label.description: Optional name for the material, recorded in the report.

name: wever_pricing-tier-check
title: Pricing tier check
